job_title: Asset & Wealth: Software Engineer Associate - Control Platform
job_description: A global investment management firm in Dallas is seeking a Software Engineer to develop web applications within Asset & Wealth Management. Candidates should have over 3 years of software development experience with proficiency in Java and React. The role involves delivering new features, collaborating with cross-functional teams for requirement gathering, and ensuring high reliability of software systems. Strong problem-solving skills and a background from a relevant degree are essential, offering a dynamic work environment and opportunities for growth.
